_comment: Feeder topology and declared hardware capabilities.
Any value written as { "value": ..., "placeholder": true } is an UNVALIDATED placeholder.
The dashboard lists every placeholder on the Trends & diagnostics page.
Nodes form a radial tree: each node names its upstream node (or SOURCE) and the section between them.
name: Prototype LV radial feeder (single phase)

nominal_voltage_v.note: Set to the actual RMS voltage of the isolated test supply. All voltage thresholds are per-unit of this value.

sensor_full_scale_v.note: Highest credible reading after calibration. Readings above this are rejected as OUT_OF_RANGE.

gauge_min_v.note: Lowest value on the node dials. Normally 0 V.

gauge_max_v.note: Highest value on the node dials. Set it to the range of the actual demonstration circuit (normally the same as sensor_full_scale_v after calibration).

transient_detection.note: Assumption A7: firmware reports per-cycle voltage_rms_min. Use REPORT_INTERVAL if it does not, or NONE.
